name: rain
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: pixel-art rain particle drawing masters for a top-down 48px-grid RPG weather overlay. Draw exactly SIX isolated enlarged pixel sprites on flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF background, evenly arranged as 3 columns by 2 rows, ample magenta between every sprite. No labels, no grid, no text. Top row: three variations of a thin SHORT rain streak leaning a little RIGHT as it falls from upper-left to lower-right; each streak is a crisp stepped line about 2 native pixels wide by 7 to 9 native pixels tall, with a pale blue-white lit core and a muted blue-grey lower-right edge, painted as big square pixel blocks. Bottom left: another short thinner diagonal rain streak. Bottom middle and bottom right: tiny 2 to 3 pixel wide angular splash ticks. All six subjects enlarged greatly and centered in their cells, consistent square pixel construction, very few colors. Think genuine SNES pixel weather at native scale, not shiny water drops. Top-left highlight. No rounded edges, no taper to hairline, no gradients, no haze, no blur, no dither, no random isolated specks, no scenery, no shadows, no backing panels. The magenta will be keyed out and these drawings will be mode-sampled to tiny native particles. Draw the carefully designed particle silhouettes; do not draw a weather field.

name: heavy_rain
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Pixel-art HEAVY RAIN particle master drawing for top-down RPG weather on a 48px cell grid. Solid pure magenta #FF00FF background. Exactly SIX separate enlarged pixel sprites, 3 columns by 2 rows, ample empty magenta gutters, no text, no panels. First four sprites: LONG slim rain streaks falling slightly right, precisely stepped rectangular silhouettes with individual square pixel blocks, about 3 native pixels wide by 12-16 pixels tall. Muted slate-blue lower-right edge, pale blue core, tiny upper-left blue-white highlight, limited 3-color palette. Rain line slender, NOT thick ice shards, NOT pointed water droplets. Last two sprites: angular tiny splash ticks 3x2 native pixels. Render as greatly enlarged native pixel art; no outlines thicker than 1 native pixel. Hard geometric edge, no gradients, no blur, no haze, no dither, no background except magenta, no isolated speck noise. Each piece will be registered and mode-reduced to native pixels; draw the particle shapes only, not an entire weather tile.

name: snow
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Pixel-art SNOW particle master sheet for a top-down RPG. Exactly SIX isolated flakes evenly spaced as a 3-column 2-row atlas on perfectly flat pure magenta #FF00FF. No labels. Each flake drawn enormously enlarged but designed to shrink to only TWO or THREE native pixels wide and tall. A mix of small soft-edged-by-color SQUARE flakes, tiny stepped L-clusters, and compact little cross-like clumps. NOT elaborate snowflake symbols, NOT asterisks. White upper-left pixel cluster, light blue middle, visible blue-grey lower-right one-pixel edge to read against snowy ground. Only three flat colors. The flakes feel gently drifting and light. Hard square pixel blocks, jagged orthogonal corners, absolutely no antialias, glow, gradients, rounded beads or shadows on the magenta. Six carefully designed tiny chunky pixel silhouettes, each centered in its spacious cell, lots of clear magenta. They will be magenta-keyed, palette-locked and exact mode-sampled to native 2x2 and 3x3 pixel drawings.

name: hail
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Pixel-art HAIL master particle atlas. Exactly SIX isolated greatly enlarged native pixel-art marks evenly in a 3-column 2-row layout on pure solid magenta #FF00FF. Top row 3 hard icy pellets, bottom left another pellet, bottom middle and right tiny angular two-pronged bounce marks. Pellets are compact square/blocky, white top-left facet and neutral cool grey dark right-bottom facet, 2x3 or 2x2 native pixels, a little taller than wide, no tails, no snowflake crosses. Bounce marks only about 3x2 native pixels. Hard ice, sharp corners, strong contrast, three flat colors white, pale grey, steel grey. Individual native pixels rendered as large crisp square blocks. No text, no labels, no panels. No gradients, dither, blur, glow, extra specks, shadows, rounded corners or scenery. This is carefully designed miniature game weather, falling straight down fast; NOT smooth 3d ice cubes.

name: blizzard-a
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Pixel-art BLIZZARD blowing snow master particle sheet, on pure flat solid magenta #FF00FF. Exactly SIX isolated drawings in evenly spaced 3-column 2-row atlas, no labels. Top row: three tiny white wind-driven snow clumps, 3x2 native pixels, stretched sideways, blue-grey lower-right pixel edge, white upper-left. Bottom row: three different longer thin sideways snow-wind streaks about 10x2, 14x3, 18x3 native pixels, stepped angular taper with one slight dogleg, NOT smooth curves. Greatly enlarge these native pixel marks with big crisp square pixels. Very small palette: white, icy off-white, pale blue-grey, medium blue-grey edges. Top-left light. Dense blizzard feeling when many instances are placed by game, but here isolate the six component sprites with lots of magenta clearance. No fog clouds, no puffy blobs, no rounded corners, no smears, gradients, blur, glow, dust/noise or scenery. Fine elegant horizontally moving pixel snow that will survive mode reduction.

name: heavy_rain-b
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Draw an enlarged pixel-art HEAVY RAIN master particle atlas on perfectly solid magenta #FF00FF. Six separated sprites in 3 columns by 2 rows. The first four are long slender stepped rain lines. CRITICAL DIRECTION: each line's TOP endpoint is on the LEFT, its BOTTOM endpoint is on the RIGHT, like a BACKSLASH \, with mostly downward and only a slight eastward/right drift. About 3 native pixels bounding width and 13-16 native pixels height, 1-pixel blue-grey shadow edge along the right, pale blue lit core on the left. Last two small sprites are 3x2 native pixel splash ticks. All individual pixel blocks square, limited flat pale blue and slate palette, hard edges. Large magenta gutters between six subjects, no text or labels or grid. No smooth lines, no water-drop shapes, no ice shards, no gradients, no noise, no glow, no blur, no dither, no cast shadows. An actual game particle design sheet, to be reduced by mode sampling.

name: blizzard-b
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Alternative pixel-art BLIZZARD particle master atlas, six separate components on solid pure #FF00FF magenta. 3 columns, 2 rows, ample clearance around each of six sprites. Top three are different wind-driven small snow clumps, about 3x2 or 4x2 native pixels: white upper-left, icy pale grey, understated darker blue-grey edge. Bottom three are THIN open angular wind ribbons, 12x3, 16x4 and 20x4 native pixels, subtly curling like a sideways angular S built of square pixels, not downward zigzags. One-pixel hair-thin tails at NATIVE scale; broadest point only 2 pixels thick. Native pixels greatly enlarged into crisp square blocks. Horizontal motion left to right. Limited flat 4-color white/blue-grey palette. No black outlines, fog, cotton clouds, blobs, translucent smears, gradients, antialiasing, glow, stars, random speckles, or background panels. No text. The overall design should read wind-driven whiteout once repeated densely, while retaining open gaps and clean discrete particle shapes.

name: sandstorm-a
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Pixel-art SANDSTORM dust-band drawing master for a top-down 48px-cell RPG. Draw exactly THREE separate wide horizontal swirling dust ribbons, stacked top/middle/bottom on perfectly solid pure magenta #FF00FF background. Each ribbon isolated with generous magenta above below and at the sides. They are three alternative particle sprites, not a landscape. Each designed at roughly 80 native pixels wide by 16 pixels tall, rendered greatly enlarged with hard square pixel steps. Long low winding ochre and warm cream dust bands flowing left to right with a few angular eddies and open magenta channels INSIDE the band, fine connected grit texture, broken long strands. At native scale all strand edges are one-pixel square steps, clear hard alpha. Palette only pale straw, warm sand gold, amber ochre and muted ochre shadow, top-left light. GOLDEN airborne sand that remains visible over tan terrain without resembling dark brown mud. Light diffuse feeling achieved only by sparse open shapes and colors; no airbrush opacity. Magenta should occupy at least half the entire sheet and much of each ribbon's interior. No rounded cloud blobs, no fog sheet, no scenery, no dirt piles, no noise speckle, no loose single-pixel dots, no glow, no gradients, no blur, no labels, no borders. Draw beautiful carefully shaped flowing bands; code will later key, mode-reduce and animate the drawings.

name: sandstorm-b
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create alternative pixel-art master sheet for airborne SANDSTORM bands. Three separate long LOW horizontal ribbons stacked vertically on solid pure magenta #FF00FF, generous magenta gutters and margins. Each ribbon will become roughly 80x12 native pixels. Draw sandy tan and ochre dust flowing LEFT TO RIGHT in broad low angular meanders, layered broken streaks, subtle gentle curling eddies, NOT flames or golden waves. Keep the height low. Light chalky straw upper edges, muted golden ochre midtones and ochre-grey low edge. Four flat colors only. A lot of open magenta slits and spaces inside each ribbon so the map can show through. Surface clustered connected pixel grit instead of noise dots. Sharp orthogonal square pixel steps, texture scale one native pixel. Each ribbon elongated and clearly different. No fire, no huge spiral curls, no brown mud, no smoke blobs, no puffs, no fog, no solid rectangular strips, no gradients or blur or tiny disconnected specks. No scenery, no labels, no grid. Image tool draws all flowing shapes and texture; code will only register, reduce, palette-lock, clean, wrap and animate these drawings.
